drills.instruction: Add the reason in brackets to the sentence.

items.cue: The shipment will arrive on 12 March. (a customs inspection)
answers: The shipment will arrive on 12 March because of a customs inspection.
Because of a customs inspection, the shipment will arrive on 12 March.

items.cue: We need to move the meeting to Thursday. (the client is travelling)
answers: We need to move the meeting to Thursday because the client is travelling.

items.cue: 很抱歉通知您，交货将推迟一周。
answers: I'm sorry to inform you that the delivery will be delayed by one week.
We regret to inform you that the delivery will be delayed by a week.

items.cue: 如有任何问题，请随时联系我。
answers: Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
